playtest.type: Automated native application component playtest using actual CitySimulation, BuildingInfo, BusinessDashboard, Overlay and click handlers, with synthetic city state. Not a full Main client walkthrough. Browser playtesting does not apply to this Java/LWJGL desktop game.
steps: Build exchange through CityCommand.EXCHANGE; staff its offices using synthetic eligible workers, click inspector Overview, advance .11 seconds and capture.
Treasury-funded market payroll assertion reconciles expected hourly quotes with actual treasury debit, without debiting private company balances.
Set treasury to zero and advance .11 seconds; assert trading closed and capture. With no funded private vacancies, unpaid staff may remain assigned but receive no wages.

Exercise actual quote response to qualified labour supply and exchange removal; hiring tests reject unqualified analyst applicants, limit role capacity, move paid workers to better funded private offers, and let unpaid workers take funded vacancies without forced rehiring. A newly graduated support worker does not cause a fifth worker to be hired.
Run prior cheapest-meal/material and local-stock regression playtest again; click Commercial filter and shop rows; capture fresh business screenshots.
playtest.expected: Wages vary with role supply and demand; treasury alone funds exchange payroll; qualified funded staff open trading; zero treasury closes trading; role limits and market job choice hold; prior goods purchasing remains correct.
playtest.observed: All playtest assertions passed. Paid image shows analyst $2.415/hour and support $0.849/hour, treasury $9399.984, Graduate staff 3 / 4 and OPEN. Unfunded image shows treasury $0.000 and CLOSED. Food purchase remains four portions with sixteen aggregate portions left; low-stock sale remains rejected.
playtest.annotation: Playtest captions display live quote, treasury and operational values from the tested simulation; they are harness annotations, not new product UI.
